rationale: CR-001 (critical) fixed: replaced async_pre_call_hook with async_pre_call_deployment_hook so the hook fires after litellm_params merge (router.py:2433-2439), making store=False from server-side model config visible and actionable. CR-002 (major) fixed: added guard 'if 0 < len(filtered) < len(input_items)' to prevent stripping input to empty list. Code refactored with early returns and comprehensive docstring per reviewer suggestions. All 16 tests pass. CR-003 deferred: id-only reasoning items not present in primary use case (Codex CLI strips rs_* ids before sending).

finding_status.notes: Fixed by switching from async_pre_call_hook to async_pre_call_deployment_hook. The deployment hook fires inside litellm.completion (utils.py:1811) after the router merges {**litellm_params, **kwargs} (router.py:2433-2439), so store=False from a model entry's litellm_params is now visible in kwargs when the hook runs.

Fixed by adding guard: 'if 0 < len(filtered) < len(input_items)'. Only replaces kwargs['input'] if the filtered list is non-empty and shorter than the original. If all items would be stripped, the input is left unchanged, surfacing the original Azure error.

Deferred per product decision. Codex CLI sends only encrypted_content (it strips rs_* ids internally), so id-only reasoning items do not appear in the primary use case. Broadening the filter to strip all reasoning items is a follow-up when/if other clients surface this scenario.

business_review.criterion: Codex CLI multi-turn requests no longer fail with 400 / rs_* not found
Reasoning items with encrypted_content stripped from input when store=False
Input not set to empty list when all items are reasoning items
Two consecutive Codex CLI turns succeed end-to-end
Non-Codex LiteLLM routing unaffected (hook only acts when store=False and reasoning items present)

standards_review.notes: Type annotations consistent with surrounding file style. Guard condition on line 74 correctly handles edge cases.
No secrets, no auth bypass, no new injection surface.
